1. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (IIa) O NaO OR2 0 (II a), in which substituent R2 is selected from the group consisting of alkyl, aryl, and arylalkyl, __wherein the compound is a sodium enolate of a β-keto ester__.

4. (Currently amended) A compound of formula (Ilb) O ZO OMe O O (I Ib) in which substituent Z is selected from the group consisting of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals, __wherein the compound is an enolate of a β-keto methyl ester__.

5. (Currently amended) A compound according to Claim 4 of formula (Il b) in which Z is __sodium__.
